body:
Closes #5.

This PR:
 - Refactors the `_fused_pairs` design, and just operates in the AST
 - Organizes/compartmentalizes files a bit
 - Adds support for `fused_pairs_flexible` (closes #5), which can operate over simple barriers (if/for loops)
 - Adds tests for `fused_pairs_flexible`, including line number information
 - Added `linefilter!` to source, which is called after the transformation, in order to keep separation of concerns
 - The returned expression from `_fused_pairs` is now `tuple()` instead of `()`.
 - Separates the `check_restrictions` from the actual code transformation
title: Add support for fused pairs across barriers
